result:
Foreman run 11:27–11:35: all work is healthy, and I made one change, re-pinning a single FEBio run that was losing speed.

**Running:** 8 FEBio pilots (pilotCS and pilotCR9 for p061, p083, p129, p120), started 11:10–11:15. Their parent stages are at t 2.56–2.91 and every log is fresh. All 8 are split runs on GPUs and keep checkpoints (`case.dmp`).

**Resources:**

| | Now |
|---|---|
| CPU | 26.1 of 32 quota cores, 3% of periods throttled |
| Memory | 137.2 of 137.4 GB, but only 24.7 GB is real process memory; the rest is page cache the system can free. No OOM kills, no memory pressure. |
| Disk `/raid` | 2.6 TB free |
| GPUs | Mine: 3 runs each on GPU 1 and 2, 1 each on GPU 3 and 4. GPUs 5 and 6 are free for me. |

**Queues:** both are empty of waiting work.
- FEBio: 0 waiting, 8 running, 2 old failures; 6 runs finished in the last 6 h, 0 in the last hour.
- Tasks: 0 waiting, 0 running, 5 old failures.

**Health:** nothing is dead, hung or crash-looping. All tmux services are up, and every service is restarted either by `resume_all.sh` or by the watchdog.

**Action:** pilotCR9_p120 (`febio` 402802) had cores spread across two NUMA nodes, and two of its threads sometimes ended up on the same core (2 of 5 samples). When that happened, its main thread fell from 100% to 56%. I moved it and its h31 parent (402801) to cores 32–35, which are in one node and were idle. Its average CPU went from 305% to 319%, and no threads shared a core in 3 samples afterwards. The other two runs with cross-node cores were not affected, so I left them alone.

**Idle:** about 6 cores and GPUs 5–6, because nothing is waiting in either queue.

**Problems and requests (each needs someone to change the scheduler code, which is outside my scope):**
- **Split windows don't resume:** after a `biocage_sched` restart or server stop, the follow-on windows (`w_flexion`, `w_extension`) of split runs can't be re-launched. This affects all 8 current runs.
- **Hidden window failures:** a split run's parent should be marked failed when any of its windows ends in ERROR. pilotST_p061 shows normal while its `w_extension` window failed.
- **Earlier failures still stand:** 5 of 6 pilotCR2 runs ended in ERROR and have not been restarted.
- **Core allocation:** `h06`/`h18` should give each run its cores from a single NUMA node.
